name: weekly-content-pipeline
description: Research, draft, review, and publish a weekly marketing blog post for the codex-ecc-custom repo using diamond parallelism for research and independent reviewers
diagram:
```mermaid
graph TD
  Plan[plan-content] --> RC[research-competitors]
  Plan --> RA[research-audience]
  Plan --> RT[research-trends]
  RC --> Syn[synthesize-research]
  RA --> Syn
  RT --> Syn
  Syn --> Draft[draft-post]
  Draft --> RevC[review-correctness]
  Draft --> RevCur[review-currency]
  Draft --> RevSrc[review-source]
  RevC --> SynRev[synthesize-reviews]
  RevCur --> SynRev
  RevSrc --> SynRev
  RevC -.->|failure| Draft
  RevCur -.->|failure| Draft
  RevSrc -.->|failure| Draft
  SynRev --> Gate[human-gate-publish]
```

nodes.responsibility: Decompose the weekly blog post objective into research angles targeting ECC skill users
Research competitor AI coding skill marketplaces and their positioning
Research target audience pain points around multi-IDE skill compatibility
Research current AI agent graph trends and news from the last 30 days
Check whether all three research outputs contain verifiable data with real sources
review_questions: Do all three research outputs contain verifiable data with real, accessible sources?

nodes.responsibility: Merge the three research outputs into one research brief for the drafter
Write the blog post draft using the merged research brief
Check whether every factual claim about ECC skills in the draft is verifiable
review_questions: Is every factual claim about ECC skills, features, and compatibility verifiable with a cited source?

nodes.responsibility: Check whether all information about IDE compatibility is current as of July 2026
review_questions: Is all IDE compatibility information current as of July 2026 (Windsurf, Devin, Autogravity, Codex)?

nodes.responsibility: Check whether every cited URL and X thread reference in the draft is real and accessible
review_questions: Is every cited URL, X thread, and documentation link in the draft a real, accessible resource?

nodes.responsibility: Merge the three review results into a single pass-or-fail decision with structured feedback
Human reviews the final draft and review summary before publishing to the blog
